# 注大乘入楞伽經

**ID:** T1791
**Volume:** T39
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經疏部
**Byline:** 宋 寶臣述
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1127
**Juans:** 10
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1791

## Contributors
- 寶臣 (A001919)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T1791 in ten fascicles is the Sòng-period commentary on [實叉難陀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E5%8F%89%E9%9B%A3%E9%99%80)'s *[Dàshèng rù léngqié jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0329)* (T672) — by far the most substantial classical commentary on the Tang *Laṅkāvatāra* and the principal medium through which the seven-fascicle version was studied in the Sòng. The genre is *zhù* 注 (running annotation): the parent sūtra is reproduced in full, with [寶臣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E8%87%A3)'s commentary inserted at each lemma.

**Abstract**

The author [寶臣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E8%87%A3) (DILA Authority A001919) is identified in the colophon as a monk of the eastern capital (東都僧) — i.e. Kāifēng under the Northern Sòng. His biographical record is otherwise essentially empty; [寶臣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E8%87%A3) is known almost solely for T1791. Date bracket follows the conservative Northern-Sòng eastern-capital window (the Sòng moved capitals to Lín'ān after 1127); within that, the doctrinal vocabulary of the commentary is consistent with a date in the eleventh century. T1791 became the most commonly used Sòng commentary on T672 in the Yuán and Míng periods, and was the basis of the late-Míng commentaries by [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) ([X326](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0343), [X327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0344)), [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) ([X328](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0345), [X329](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346)), [通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4) ([X331](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0348)), and others.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0329](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0329) (大乘入楞伽經 / T672); cognate Huáyán commentary [KR6i0333](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0333) (入楞伽心玄義 / T1790).
